# SheetJS Community Edition

- Version: 0.20.3, mini standalone build (XLSX export).
- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- License: Apache-2.0, see `SheetJS-LICENSE.txt`.
- Loaded from this local copy only when exporting; no runtime CDN requests.

## ZXing 相機條碼辨識

`zxing-browser-0.2.1.min.js` 取自 https://unpkg.com/@zxing/browser@0.2.1/umd/zxing-browser.min.js ，固定版本，首次點擊相機才載入本機檔案。Browser 層 MIT 授權見 `ZXing-Browser-LICENSE.txt`；內含 ZXing LibraryApache-2.0 授權見 `ZXing-Library-LICENSE.txt`。執行時不使用 CDN。
